title: Research-backed elicitation
statement: The system shall provide an elicit workflow that fans out standards research, asks the user at most 4 rounds of multiple-choice questions and runs an adversarial MECE review before persisting requirements.
rationale: Reverse-engineered from the implemented reqforge 0.2 behaviour.

acceptance_criteria.text: The elicit skill orchestrates standards-researcher fan-out, requirements-analyst drafting, AskUserQuestion rounds (max 4) and mece-reviewer
The elicitation transcript is saved as an ELI session and the requirement set is persisted with upsert_many, linted and synced
